description: GENERATED by python3 -m scripts.collector_factory.generate from config/collector-factory — do not edit. Merged into the collector catalog by mcp_gateway.catalog.load_collectors (same default-deny rules).

collectors.title: Instance(s) state and uptime in hours (names masked; no absolute dates)
Operational state of the instance(s): status, role, shutdown pending, uptime in hours
Database protection and flashback state (V$DATABASE, enums only)
Registry components: id, version and status
Control file copies and record section usage
Online redo log groups: size, status and member count
Sessions by status and type, blocked sessions and longest active call (seconds)
Undo tablespace (masked), configured and tuned undo retention (seconds)
Tablespace usage percent of maximum size (names masked)
Datafile sizing and autoextend per tablespace (file names not exposed)
Temporary files sizing and free space per temporary tablespace (file names not exposed)
Invalid objects by owner and type (owner and object names masked)
Object counts by owner (masked), type and status
Scheduler jobs broken, failed or with failures (names masked; hours since last start)
Outstanding server alerts by type, level and age in hours (message text not exposed)
Archive destinations: kind, status, error flag and hours since last archived log (paths and error text not exposed)
Non-default initialization parameters: name and value only as number, TRUE/FALSE, version or closed keyword
SPFILE parameter count and parameters modified since startup (value only as number, TRUE/FALSE, version or closed keyword)
Top 25 non-idle wait events since startup: waits, timeouts, time and average wait (no license)
Non-idle wait time by wait class since startup (no license)
DB time and DB CPU in seconds since startup, and uptime (no license)
Dominant I/O and commit wait events since startup
Datafile read/write counts and average latency in ms (file paths not exposed, tablespace masked)
Library cache hit ratios, reloads and invalidations by namespace
PGA target, in use, allocated, freeable and over-allocation count
SGA size, maximum, free and main pools in bytes
Shared pool free and total bytes and dictionary cache hit ratio
Redo size, redo entries, commits and rollbacks since startup
Total and hard parse counts and session cursor cache hits since startup
Top 20 SQL by elapsed time from the shared pool: sql_id and metrics only, never SQL text (no license)
Blocked sessions: waiter and blocker session ids, event, wait class, seconds waiting and waiter sql_id
Top 50 temporary segment consumers: session, sql_id, tablespace (masked), contents and bytes
Active parallel execution servers per query coordinator: group, set, server number and degree
Log switches per thread in the last 24 hours by hour back (no dates)
System privileges granted to every role of the database (role names masked; Oracle-maintained flag)
Roles granted to roles across the database (names masked; Oracle-maintained flag)
Unified audit summary of the last 7 days by action and return code (counts only)
Traditional session audit summary of the last 7 days by action and return code (counts only)
Directory objects and their grants (names and grantees masked; server paths not exposed)
Accounts that still have their default credentials: masked username, account status and Oracle-maintained flag
AWR DB time and DB CPU per snapshot interval in the last 24 hours (deltas; Diagnostics Pack)
AWR top 20 SQL by elapsed time in the last 24 hours: sql_id and metrics, never SQL text (Diagnostics Pack)
AWR top 20 non-idle wait events in the last 24 hours (deltas; Diagnostics Pack)
ASH activity of the last 60 minutes by wait class, event and sql_id (samples; Diagnostics Pack)
PDBs seen from CDB$ROOT: open mode, restricted, recovery status, size, hours since open, application/proxy flags and local undo (names masked)
PDB services and the instances where they are active (service names masked)
PDB plug-in violations summarized by container, type, status and cause (no message text)
Enabled unified audit policies: Oracle-maintained name or CUSTOM, entity type and scope, success/failure (no user or role names)
Password profile limits per container: profile kind, resource and limit keyword/value (profile names masked, custom verify functions not exposed)
Password-file users and their administrative privileges (user names masked)
RMAN persistent configuration: setting name, classified value and number (raw values and paths never exposed); no rows means all defaults
Database UTC clock (seconds since 1970) and time zone offset; the gateway compares it with its own clock (clock_check, CLOCK_SKEW above 300 s)
Containers the diagnostic account can see from CDB$ROOT (CONTAINER_DATA attribute; PDB names masked)
Database accounts per container: status, profile, authentication type, common/Oracle-maintained flags and ages in hours (names masked; own or open accounts from 12.1.0.2)
Data Redaction policies counted by enabled state and redaction function (no owner, object, column or policy names)
Database Vault option and registry status (reading status is not using the option)
Oracle Label Security option status (reading status is not using the option)
Database links per container: masked owner and name, public or private, fixed or connected user, kind of target (host and username never leave the database)
TDE-encrypted columns counted per container, masked owner and algorithm (no table or column names)
Tablespaces per container encrypted or not, and the TDE algorithm (names masked)
Object privileges counted per grantee and privilege (masked grantee; Oracle-maintained grantees excluded from 12.1.0.2; no owners or objects)
Accounts counted per password verifier versions, container and Oracle-maintained flag (no user names, no verifiers)
Object privileges granted to PUBLIC, counted per privilege and owner (own schemas masked; Oracle schemas aggregated)
System privileges granted to PUBLIC per container
Roles granted to own users and roles per container: Oracle role by name or CUSTOM, admin option and default flag (grantees and own roles masked)
Roles counted per container, common and Oracle-maintained flags (no names)
Security-relevant initialization parameters: default flag and value only as number, TRUE/FALSE or closed keyword
System privileges granted directly to own users and roles per container (masked grantee; Oracle-maintained grantees excluded from 12.1.0.2)
TDE keystore per container: type, status, wallet type, order, united/isolated mode and backup flag (the keystore path never leaves the database)
Archived log backup coverage per thread of the current incarnation: logs in the last 24 h, on disk, not backed up, and hours since the oldest unprotected and the last archived log (no paths or dates)
Datafile backup coverage per container: datafiles never backed up, without a full or level 0, and the worst age of the latest backup and full (no file names or dates)
Backup pieces per device type and status (available, expired, unavailable): count, bytes and hours since the newest and oldest (no handles or tags)
Lockdown profiles per container: Oracle or custom profile (custom names masked), rule type, rule status and rule count (no rules or clauses)
PDB saved states for this instance: container, saved state and restricted flag (PDB and instance names masked); a PDB without a row has no saved state
CDB resource plan directives: Oracle or custom plan, active flag, directive kind, shares, utilization and parallel server limits (plan and PDB names masked)
Resource usage per PDB over the last minute: CPU, sessions, parallel servers, SGA/PGA and I/O with their limits (plan name masked; no AWR or ASH)
User sessions per PDB, instance and service: total, active and inactive (service names masked; no session details)
ASM disk health per disk group and failure group: disks, capacity in MB, not member, not online, not normal, and read/write errors (failure group masked; no paths or disk names; no disk discovery)
Enqueue locks per container, lock type and mode: count, waiting, blocking and the longest time in mode (no sessions, SQL ids or object ids)
TDE master keys per container: key count, keys not backed up and hours since the newest activation (no key ids, tags or dates)
Database mode: ARCHIVELOG, force logging, minimal supplemental logging, open mode, edition, CDB and block change tracking (masked unique name, no banner text or file names)
SQL patch history per container: action, status, patch type, target version and hours since the action (no descriptions, log files or dates)
Oracle features with detected usage per container: usages, currently used and hours since first and last usage and last sample (license review input, never proof of licensing; no feature info)
Optimizer statistics per container and owner kind (fixed objects, Oracle, custom): tables without, stale or locked statistics and age of the last analysis (no table or schema names)
Automated maintenance tasks per container: status, enabled maintenance windows, runs and runs not succeeded in 7 days and hours since the last success (no window or job names)
Scheduler and legacy DBMS_JOB jobs per container, owner kind and state: jobs, jobs with failures, max failure count and worst hours since the last run (no job names, owners or code)

UNDO statistics of the last 24 hours per container: undo generated, longest query, tuned retention, ORA-01555 and space errors, extent steals and active/unexpired/expired undo of the last interval (no sql_id or dates)
TEMP peak usage since startup per container and temporary tablespace: sort segment, used, max used, largest sort, allocated and autoextend max size in MB (masked tablespace, no file names)
Dynamic SGA components including java and streams pool: current, min, max and user-specified size, resize operations since startup and the last operation
PGA work area executions since startup (optimal, one-pass, multi-pass), PGA cache hit percentage, extra bytes read/written and max PGA allocated
Instance startup history from AWR: startups in AWR, in 7 and 30 days, hours since the last startup, distinct versions and hours of AWR history (Diagnostics Pack; no names or dates)
